info.name: Text Anonymizer
info.description:
Detect and redact personal and sensitive information (PII) in text and text files, for example before using the text in an AI prompt.
Powered by [Presidio](https://presidio.dataprivacystack.org/).
### Features
- **Detect sensitive text**: a TaskProcessing task that lists each distinct PII entity found in a text. - **Redact sensitive text**: a TaskProcessing task that replaces each PII entity with a placeholder naming its type, e.g. `Call John at 555-123-4567` becomes `Call <PERSON> at <PHONE_NUMBER>`. - **Redact text files**: a "Redact text" action in Files that saves a redacted copy next to the original text file, which is left unchanged. - **Configurable detection**: administrators can set a confidence threshold, ignore entity types and allow-list patterns under Administration settings (ExApps Settings), with environment-variable fallbacks. - Detects names, email addresses, phone numbers, locations, dates, credit card numbers, IBANs, IP addresses, URLs and more. - Handles long texts and reports task progress.
### Limitations
- English only. - Detection is not perfect: some sensitive text may be missed and some harmless text may be redacted. Check the output before relying on it. - Redaction cannot be undone, and the detection task's output contains the sensitive values it found. - The Files action only supports UTF-8 encoded plain text files, not documents such as ODT, DOCX or PDF. - Tasks are processed one at a time on the CPU.
info.author: Edward Ly

variable.name: TEXT_ANONYMIZER_SCORE_THRESHOLD
variable.description: Optional. Environment fallback for the admin setting of the same name (Administration settings, ExApps Settings): a value an admin saves there overrides this one. Minimum confidence score (0.0 to 1.0) for an entity to be reported or redacted; until this or the admin setting is set, entities are reported regardless of confidence. Suggested value: 0.5.

variable.name: TEXT_ANONYMIZER_IGNORED_ENTITY_TYPES
variable.description: Optional. Environment fallback for the admin setting of the same name (Administration settings, ExApps Settings). Comma-separated entity types that are never reported or redacted, for example URL,DATE_TIME. Default: empty.

variable.name: TEXT_ANONYMIZER_ALLOW_PATTERNS
variable.description: Optional. Environment fallback for the admin setting of the same name (Administration settings, ExApps Settings). Regular expressions, one per line, or joined with | on one line (the admin form takes one line: use | there, not commas). A detected entity is kept as-is when one of them matches its whole text, or when it sits inside a match of one, for example public company names. A pattern that matches only part of a longer name does not keep it. A pattern that is invalid, that can match nothing or that takes too long on a text is ignored with a warning in the ExApp log. Default: empty.
